title: Campaign
description: content/campaigns/*.json. Mirrors packages/shared/src/types/chapter.ts Campaign; where the two disagree the TypeScript type wins. A campaign is a story arc of 4-8 chapters and the unit of the carryover commitment rule (spec §6, §8.2).

_note.description: Author-facing note that survives into the shipped JSON. Ignored by the loader.

chapters.description: Chapter ids in play order. Each must exist under content/chapters/ and their `index` values must run 1..n with no gaps — checked by tools/content/validate.mjs.
